caption: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth fills a white bowl with blue geometric trim. Topped with tender chashu pork, nori, and green onions, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, reddish-brown wooden surface with visible grain patterns and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork appears as tender, light brown slices with slightly glossy surface and irregular, curled edges.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and irregularly shaped with a slightly wrinkled, textured surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
The ceramic bowl has a white interior, blue geometric rim pattern, and smooth, glossy surface.
